Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning - the demo was helpful and we're excited to kick off a short POC to validate latency and relevancy for our clinical-note summarization workflow. A few quick items from our side: 

- Success criteria: 1) average inference latency < 450ms at 4k tokens, 2) F1 > 0.85 on our evaluation set, 3) no PHI leakage in outputs across 200 sample queries.
- Timeline: ideally 3 weeks (kickoff next Monday if possible).
- Evaluation owners: Alex (clinical), Lisa (engineering).
